branch_hours_range_check.name: branch_hours_range_check
branch_hours_range_check.value: "branch_hours"."weekday" between 1 and 7 and "branch_hours"."start_minute" between 0 and 1439 and "branch_hours"."end_minute" between 1 and 1440 and "branch_hours"."end_minute" <> "branch_hours"."start_minute"

counter_payments_khr_check.name: counter_payments_khr_check
counter_payments_khr_check.value: ("counter_payments"."method" = 'cash_khr') = ("counter_payments"."amount_khr" is not null and "counter_payments"."khr_per_usd" is not null)

counter_payments_return_check.name: counter_payments_return_check
counter_payments_return_check.value: ("counter_payments"."return_method" is null and "counter_payments"."returned_at" is null and "counter_payments"."returned_by" is null) or ("counter_payments"."return_method" in ('cash', 'khqr') and "counter_payments"."returned_at" is not null and "counter_payments"."returned_by" is not null)

menu_availability_windows_range_check.name: menu_availability_windows_range_check
menu_availability_windows_range_check.value: "menu_availability_windows"."weekday" between 1 and 7 and "menu_availability_windows"."start_minute" between 0 and 1439 and "menu_availability_windows"."end_minute" between 1 and 1440 and "menu_availability_windows"."end_minute" <> "menu_availability_windows"."start_minute"

menu_item_modifier_groups_rules_check.name: menu_item_modifier_groups_rules_check
menu_item_modifier_groups_rules_check.value: not "menu_item_modifier_groups"."rules_overridden" or ("menu_item_modifier_groups"."min_select" >= 0 and ("menu_item_modifier_groups"."max_select" is null or ("menu_item_modifier_groups"."max_select" >= 1 and "menu_item_modifier_groups"."max_select" >= "menu_item_modifier_groups"."min_select")))

order_events_status_check.name: order_events_status_check
order_events_status_check.value: "order_events"."to_status" in ('awaiting_payment', 'preparing', 'ready', 'completed', 'cancelled') and ("order_events"."from_status" is null or "order_events"."from_status" in ('awaiting_payment', 'preparing', 'ready', 'completed', 'cancelled'))

orders_type_check.name: orders_type_check
orders_type_check.value: ("orders"."order_type" = 'pickup' and "orders"."table_id" is null) or ("orders"."order_type" = 'dine_in' and "orders"."table_id" is not null)
